rows.label: tlk70000119_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Just carry straight on
down this road and you'll
come to Torigo Village.

rows.label: tlk70000119_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Try to stay on the road,
though, OK? There are some
pretty scary monsters around.

rows.label: tlk70000119_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Sometimes I see travelers stray far
from the road while they're absorbed
in exploring...

rows.label: tlk70000119_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Travelers end up forced into a
life-or-death chase with some
seriously dangerous monsters.

rows.label: tlk70000119_01_msg0005
rows.name:
That's part of the fun of adventuring,
but if you value your life like I do,
stick to the road.
